# Cython extension modules for the pcl package.
# The pyx files cimport declarations from src/pcl/pxd/ (auto-generated by
# cppast2autopxd; regenerate with `python pxdgen/generate.py`).

# _pointcloud.pyx -> _pointcloud extension module
add_cython_target(_pointcloud CXX PY3)
add_library(_pointcloud MODULE ${_pointcloud})
target_link_libraries(_pointcloud ${PCL_LIBRARIES})
python_extension_module(_pointcloud)
install(TARGETS _pointcloud LIBRARY DESTINATION src/pcl)
